If you want the game to read gamepad input as keyboard input (so AABSZ thinks it’s just keyboard presses), you need a plugin that maps gamepad buttons to keyboard keys.
WolfpadMVZ used to do exactly that, but it’s hard to find now. You can try searching for it again in RPG Maker forums or archived plugin lists.
Another option is using a tool outside the engine, like
JoyToKey
or
AntiMicro
. They convert gamepad input into keyboard input at the system level, so the game reads it as normal key presses without needing a special plugin. That’s usually the easiest and most reliable way.
If you already downloaded that custom plugin mentioned above, test it first. If it works for your key mapping needs, you’re good. If not, JoyToKey is probably your safest bet.
